bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; clarifying criminal penalty provisions for assaulting transit workers; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.2231, subdivision 11.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.2231, subdivision 11, is amended to read:

Subd. 11.
Transit [-operators-][+ workers+].
(a) A person is guilty of a gross misdemeanor if (1) the person assaults a transit [-operator-][+ worker+], or intentionally throws or otherwise transfers bodily fluids onto a transit [-operator-][+ worker+]; and (2) the transit [-operator-][+ worker+] is [-acting in the course of the operator's duties and is operating a transit vehicle, aboard a transit vehicle, or otherwise responsible for a transit vehicle-][+ engaged in the performance of the worker's duties+]. A person convicted under this paragraph may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than 364 days or to payment of a fine of not more than $3,000, or both.
(b) For the purposes of this subdivision, "transit [-operator-][+ worker+]" means [-a driver or operator of a transit vehicle that is used to provide any of the following services:-][+ an employee, contractor, or volunteer working in public transportation or transit as defined under section 473.121, subdivision 19. +]

[-(1) public transportation, as defined in section 174.22, subdivision 7; -]

[-(2) light rail transit service; -]

[-(3) special transportation service under section 473.386, whether provided by the Metropolitan Council or by other providers under contract with the council; or -]

[-(4) commuter rail service. -]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; clarifying criminal penalty provisions for assaulting transit workers; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.2231, subdivision 11.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.2231, subdivision 11, is amended to read:

Subd. 11.
Transit workers.
(a) A person is guilty of a gross misdemeanor if (1) the person assaults a transit worker, or intentionally throws or otherwise transfers bodily fluids onto a transit worker; and (2) the transit worker is engaged in the performance of the worker's duties. A person convicted under this paragraph may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than 364 days or to payment of a fine of not more than $3,000, or both.
(b) For the purposes of this subdivision, "transit worker" means an employee, contractor, or volunteer working in public transportation or transit as defined under section 473.121, subdivision 19.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date.
additions: engaged in the performance of the worker's duties
an employee, contractor, or volunteer working in public transportation or transit as defined under section 473.121, subdivision 19.
This section is effective August 1, 2026, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date.
deletions: acting in the course of the operator's duties and is operating a transit vehicle, aboard a transit vehicle, or otherwise responsible for a transit vehicle
a driver or operator of a transit vehicle that is used to provide any of the following services:
(1) public transportation, as defined in section 174.22, subdivision 7 ;
(3) special transportation service under section 473.386 , whether provided by the Metropolitan Council or by other providers under contract with the council; or
